world: One painted storyboard image, three panels across and three down, read left to right and top to bottom, with consistent faces, clothing, rain and colour throughout. Heavy rain falls through diffuse grey dawn light, with faint amber at the horizon, muted greens, red-brown earth, dark shadows and small wet highlights. Canal-side skylight rims wet hair and clothing without brightening the sheltered faces. Aruni has warm medium-brown skin, broad cheekbones, large dark eyes and centre-parted black hair secured in a wet low bun. She wears the reference white collared nurse's dress, white waist belt, white closed shoes and silver ear studs. Her small navy medical bag has black piping and short black handles. Nimal has matching family cheekbones, a broader face, neat black moustache and flattened short wavy hair. His soaked rust-brown shirt has sleeves rolled to the forearms; he wears dark brown trousers, a black belt and dark sandals. His eyes remain closed and his right fist remains closed around the small metal key. The phone is the scuffed black reference smartphone. Use the supplied references for likenesses and materials, not repeated location framing. Draw no panel labels, captions, dialogue, titles or readable lettering; object markings remain indistinct.
geography: The muddy field-edge path connects the paddy zone at screen left to the canal-gate zone at screen right. Aruni travels across the picture toward screen right, rather than away into the landscape. A long grass-topped red-earth bund and the adjacent strip of brown canal water remain at frame left in both the field wide and the gate reveal; these connect the two positions. Green paddy extends into the upper-left distance. At the right-hand destination, the bank widens beside a stained concrete sluice throat, rust-brown gate and vertical spindle. Every camera stays on the landward bank side of the action axis. Nimal lies across the lower gate-side bank, head at screen right and feet toward the water at screen left, with his right fist on the near-camera side of his torso. Aruni stops to his left and subsequently kneels beside that fist, retaining the bag in her left hand.

panels.camera: Standing-height wide, 35mm feel with deep focus, from the landward bank slightly behind Aruni's shoulder line. Look obliquely across the path for a rear three-quarter side view of her left-to-right travel, not a view directly along her back.
panels.background: Waterlogged green paddy fills the upper-left distance. The grass-topped red-earth bund and a strip of brown canal water occupy frame left; the muddy path makes a shallow diagonal toward the right edge. The gate and Nimal are outside the right edge.
panels.picture: Aruni is upright in the left third, occupying about one quarter of the panel, caught in a rightward walking step with her face turned screen right. Her navy medical bag hangs from her left hand, and her empty right hand rests beside her dress. Rain streaks cross the open field and catch the wet edges of her white uniform.

She looks down toward Nimal, who lies still across the lower right with his head on the bank at screen right and feet extending left toward the water. His closed eyes and moustached face are readable, while his closed right fist rests beside his torso without exposing the key.

conflicts: Aruni's look sheet includes a white medical bag, while the dedicated bag reference and prop specification show navy. Use the dedicated navy bag reference throughout.

Several shot positions place the phone in a trouser pocket, but Aruni's approved clothing is a nurse's dress. Keep the dress and leave the phone concealed until shot 7 without inventing visible trousers or a pocket.
Shot 5 specifies a sand-coloured cuff, but Nimal's approved shirt and reference are rust-brown with rolled sleeves. Use the rust-brown rolled sleeve edge and exposed forearm.
Shot 6 requests closed lips in its opening picture but also assigns Aruni a spoken line. The speaker-readability rule takes priority, so her mouth is shown mid-word.

The key insert requests a readable code and the phone insert requests a readable contact name. The no-text rule takes priority: retain the marked key surface and phone interface without readable characters.
The supplied axis ends with an incomplete bag instruction. The explicit shot positions are followed: Aruni retains the bag in her left hand throughout.
